question: Look for FDA safety communications about montelukast. Summarize only the returned notice titles or excerpts, link to them, and explain if full notice text was not retrieved. No personal treatment recommendations.
criteria: Safety notices, not recall substitution. No unsupported mechanisms or personal treatment instructions from memory. Disclose title-only or incomplete index evidence. Empty result not proof no safety notices exist.
answer:
### FDA safety communication returned

- **Date:** March 4, 2020  
- **Title:** “FDA requires Boxed Warning about serious mental health side effects for asthma and allergy drug montelukast (Singulair); advises restricting use for allergic rhinitis” [S2](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-communications/fda-requires-boxed-warning-about-serious-mental-health-side-effects-asthma-and-allergy-drug)

The retrieval returned the notice title and direct source record, but **not the full notice text or excerpts**. It searched the current FDA safety-communications index and does not establish that all historical alerts were searched. The returned population context and age-band applicability were not established. [S1](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-and-availability/drug-safety-communications) [S2](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-communications/fda-requires-boxed-warning-about-serious-mental-health-side-effects-asthma-and-allergy-drug)

Informational only; not medical advice. Compiled from public NIH/NLM/FDA data, which may be incomplete or out of date. Patients should talk to a clinician, pharmacist or poison control before starting, stopping or changing any medication.
